source_title: Sample (paraphrased from FTA Taxable Person Guide for VAT)
heading: Mandatory registration
text: A UAE resident must register for VAT when the value of its taxable supplies and imports over the previous 12 months exceeds the mandatory registration threshold of AED 375,000, or when it expects that value to exceed AED 375,000 in the next 30 days.

source_title: Sample (paraphrased from FTA Taxable Person Guide for VAT)
heading: Voluntary registration
text: A business may register voluntarily when its taxable supplies and imports, or its taxable expenses, exceed the voluntary registration threshold of AED 187,500.

source_title: Sample (paraphrased from FTA Taxable Person Guide for VAT)
heading: Notification deadline
text: A person who is required to register must apply to the FTA within 30 days of becoming required to register.

source_title: Sample (paraphrased from FTA Taxable Person Guide for VAT)
heading: VAT rate
text: The standard rate of VAT in the UAE is 5%. Some supplies are zero-rated and some are exempt.

source_title: Sample (paraphrased from FTA Corporate Tax General Guide)
heading: Corporate tax rates
text: Taxable income up to AED 375,000 is taxed at 0%. Taxable income above AED 375,000 is taxed at 9%.

source_title: Sample (paraphrased from FTA Corporate Tax General Guide)
heading: Small Business Relief
text: A resident person whose revenue does not exceed AED 3,000,000 in the relevant tax period and in all previous tax periods can elect for Small Business Relief.

source_title: Sample (paraphrased from FTA Corporate Tax Returns Guide)
heading: Filing deadline
text: A corporate tax return must be filed, and any tax due paid, within 9 months from the end of the relevant tax period.
